adjudication.rationale: In `GroupsController#members`, the diff sets `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` and `offset = params[:offset].to_i` and passes them directly into `group.users...limit(limit).offset(offset)` with no validation/clamping. From the diff alone, a negative `offset` (e.g. "-1") will be used and can cause Postgres/ActiveRecord to error (500). Likewise `limit=0` is propagated into the client via `meta.limit`, and the new client computations `currentPage`/`totalPages` divide by `this.get("limit")`, which would become a divide-by-zero/Infinity/NaN case. An excessively large `limit` would also be honored and can return an unbounded number of members.
